name: bang-motion
description: Bang Motion — Agent skill dan starter explainer motion graphic untuk Cartoon Stage, Continuous Action, dan Cartoon Collage.

scripts.dev: node -e "import('node:http').then(async({default:h})=>{const{readFile:rf}=await import('node:fs/promises');const p=await import('node:path');const m={'.html':'text/html; charset=utf-8','.svg':'image/svg+xml','.jpg':'image/jpeg','.png':'image/png','.css':'text/css','.js':'text/javascript','.md':'text/markdown; charset=utf-8','.json':'application/json'};h.createServer(async(q,r)=>{r.setHeader('Cache-Control','no-store');const u=decodeURIComponent((q.url||'/').split('?')[0]);const f=p.resolve('.',u==='/'?'index.html':u.slice(1));if(!f.startsWith(p.resolve('.'))){r.writeHead(403);return r.end();}try{const d=await rf(f);r.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':m[p.extname(f)]||'application/octet-stream'});r.end(d);}catch{r.writeHead(404);r.end('Not Found');}}).listen(Number(process.env.PORT)||3000,'0.0.0.0',()=>console.log('Preview sementara aktif di port 3000'));})"
scripts.build: node -e "import('node:fs').then(async fs=>{const vm=await import('node:vm');const req=['SKILL.md','README.md','references/reference-index.md','references/explainer-core.md','references/anti-ppt.md','references/asset-consistency.md','references/cartoon-stage.md','references/continuous-action.md','references/cartoon-collage.md','references/visuals/shared-camera-composition.svg','references/visuals/shared-scale-perspective.svg','references/visuals/shared-good-vs-bad.svg','references/visuals/stage-anatomy.svg','references/visuals/stage-poses-expressions.svg','references/visuals/continuous-viewpoints-continuity.svg','references/visuals/collage-spatial-blueprints.svg','examples/good-vs-bad.md','examples/before-after.md','examples/case-cartoon-stage.md','examples/case-continuous-action.md','examples/case-cartoon-collage.md','templates/production-brief.md','templates/qc-audit-scorecard.md','assets/starter-cartoon-stage.html','assets/starter-continuous-action.html','assets/starter-cartoon-collage.html'];for(const f of req){if(!fs.existsSync(f))throw new Error('Berkas skill hilang: '+f);}for(const f of req.filter(x=>x.endsWith('.svg'))){const s=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8').trim();if(!s.startsWith('<svg')||!s.endsWith('</svg>'))throw new Error('SVG tidak valid: '+f);}for(const f of [...req.filter(x=>x.endsWith('.html')),'index.html']){const html=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');for(const m of html.matchAll(/<script(?![^>]*\bsrc=)[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/g)){new vm.Script(m[1],{filename:f});}}for(const f of [...req.filter(x=>x.endsWith('.md')),'index.html']){const txt=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');if(txt.includes('docs/gallery')||txt.includes('sample-beat-sheets.md'))throw new Error('Tautan usang ditemukan di: '+f);}console.log('Agent Skill Bang Motion v2.1.0 tervalidasi ('+req.length+' berkas inti).');})"
